t: 密歇根领地创建.
te: The Michigan Territory is created.
dz: 密歇根领地创建.
de: The Michigan Territory is created.

t: 塞缪尔·蔡斯法官在美国参议院接受弹劾审判后被判无罪.
te: Justice Samuel Chase is acquitted at the end of his impeachment trial before the U.S. Senate.
dz: 塞缪尔·蔡斯法官在美国参议院接受弹劾审判后被判无罪.

t: 意大利共和国以拿破仑为总统,成为意大利王国,拿破仑为意大利国王.
te: The Italian Republic, with Napoleon as president, becomes the Kingdom of Italy, with Napoleon as King of Italy.
dz: 意大利共和国以拿破仑为总统,成为意大利王国,拿破仑为意大利国王.

t: 德国作曲家路德维希·范·贝多芬在维也纳维也纳剧院首演他的《第三交响曲》。
te: German composer Ludwig van Beethoven premieres his Third Symphony, at the Theater an der Wien in Vienna.
dz: 德国作曲家路德维希·范·贝多芬在维也纳维也纳剧院首演他的《第三交响曲》。

t: 发现军团在曼丹部落中突破了营地并恢复了沿密苏里河向西行进.
te: The Corps of Discovery breaks camp among the Mandan tribe and resumes its journey West along the Missouri River.
dz: 刘易斯和克拉克远征:发现军团在曼丹部落中突破了营地并恢复了沿密苏里河向西行进.
de: Lewis and Clark Expedition: The Corps of Discovery breaks camp among the Mandan tribe and resumes its journey West along the Missouri River.

t: 美国海军陆战队在普雷斯利·奥班农中尉的指挥下占领了德尔恩。
te: United States Marines capture Derne under the command of First Lieutenant Presley O'Bannon.
dz: 第一次巴巴里战争：美国海军陆战队在普雷斯利·奥班农中尉的指挥下占领了德尔恩。
de: First Barbary War: United States Marines capture Derne under the command of First Lieutenant Presley O'Bannon.

te: Muhammad Ali becomes Wāli of Egypt.
dz: 穆罕默德·阿里成为了埃及的Wāli.

dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴在米兰哥特式大教堂米兰大教堂加冕为意大利国王，并加冕伦巴第铁王冠。
de: Napoléon Bonaparte assumes the title of King of Italy and is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy in Milan Cathedral, the gothic cathedral in Milan.

t: 法军和西班牙部队开始出击占领马提尼克地产地钻石岩的英国部队.
te: French and Spanish forces begin the assault against British forces occupying Diamond Rock, Martinique.
dz: 法军和西班牙部队开始出击占领马提尼克地产地钻石岩的英国部队.
de: French and Spanish forces begin the assault against British forces occupying Diamond Rock, Martinique.

t: 法国-西班牙舰队从英国手中夺回了钻石岩岛，该岛守卫着通往马提尼克岛法兰西堡的海湾入口。

dz: 拿破仑战争：法国-西班牙舰队从英国手中夺回了钻石岩岛，该岛守卫着通往马提尼克岛法兰西堡的海湾入口。
de: Napoleonic Wars: A Franco-Spanish fleet recaptures from the British the island of Diamond Rock, which guards the entrance to the bay leading to Fort-de-France, Martinique.

t: 优素福·卡拉曼利签署了一项条约，结束的黎波里塔尼亚和美国之间的敌对行动。
te: Yusuf Karamanli signs a treaty ending the hostilities between Tripolitania and the United States.
dz: 第一次巴巴里战争：优素福·卡拉曼利签署了一项条约，结束的黎波里塔尼亚和美国之间的敌对行动。
de: First Barbary War: Yusuf Karamanli signs a treaty ending the hostilities between Tripolitania and the United States.

t: 一场大火消耗了密歇根领地的底特律一大部分.
te: A fire consumes large portions of Detroit in the Michigan Territory.
dz: 一场大火消耗了密歇根领地的底特律一大部分.
de: A fire consumes large portions of Detroit in the Michigan Territory.

t: 在探险队前方进行侦察,梅里韦瑟·刘易斯和四名同伴目击了密苏里河大瀑布.
te: Scouting ahead of the expedition, Meriwether Lewis and four companions sight the Great Falls of the Missouri River.
dz: 刘易斯和克拉克远征队:在探险队前方进行侦察,梅里韦瑟·刘易斯和四名同伴目击了密苏里河大瀑布.
de: Lewis and Clark Expedition: Scouting ahead of the expedition, Meriwether Lewis and four companions sight the Great Falls of the Missouri River.

t: 下 1805年1月11日美国国会通过的将印第安纳领地划分为两个独立政府的法令,密歇根领地被组织…

dz: 下 1805年1月11日美国国会通过的将印第安纳领地划分为两个独立政府的法令,密歇根领地被组织起来.
de: Under An act to divide the Indiana Territory into two separate governments, adopted by the U.S. Congress on January 11, 1805, the Michigan Territory is organized.

te: War of the Third Coalition: Battle of Cape Finisterre: An inconclusive naval action is fought between a combined French…
dz: 拿破仑战争：第三次反法同盟战争：菲尼斯特雷角海战：法国海军上将皮埃尔-查尔斯·维伦纽夫领导的法国和西班牙联合舰队与罗伯特·考尔德海军上将领导的英国舰队之间进行了一场没有结果的海军行动。
de: Napoleonic Wars: War of the Third Coalition: Battle of Cape Finisterre: An inconclusive naval action is fought between a combined French and Spanish fleet under Admiral Pierre-Charles Villeneuve of France and a British fleet under Admiral Robert Calder.

te: Napoleon Bonaparte invades Austria during the War of the Third Coalition.
dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴在第三次反法同盟战争期间入侵奥地利。
